    fits = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)

        # Weighted score: higher if bin capacity is moderate and leftover space is moderate

        combined = weight_current * current_norm + weight_remaining * remaining_norm
        priority_scores[fits] = combined
    return priority_scores

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:

    fits = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)

    utilization_ratio = item / bins
    # Adjust priority based on post-addition utilization: higher is better

    priority_scores[fits] = -(1 - post_utilization[fits])

    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.

    fits = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)

            leftover_score = np.ones_like(leftover)
        # Weighted sum favoring ratio slightly more
        priority_scores[fits] = 0.6 * ratio + 0.4 * leftover_score
    
    return priority_scores
